card.name: "Out of" in keep-away-from-children warnings
card.fires_on: The small word "of" right after "out" in "Keep this and all medication out of reach of children", especially on its repeated second occurrence. Also weakly on linking words like "in" or "from" in set phrases.

modes.label: Out of reach
modes.description: The word "of" after "keep ... out" in the child-safety storage line.
modes.example: Keep this and all medication out<< of>> reach of children.

modes.label: Other set phrases
modes.description: A linking word inside a fixed phrase, such as "late in pregnancy" or "Emissions from Deforestation".
